title: HARMVIDEOBENCH: Benchmarking Harmful Video Understanding in Large Multimodal Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy and reasoning capabilities across English, Chinese, and mixed-language video subsets to identify cross-lingual performance disparities, particularly in complex reasoning tasks.
Evaluating models' ability to understand localized cultural tropes, historically grounded context, and community-specific slang through a 'Beyond-Clip Reasoning' multiple-choice evaluation.

Testing model comprehension of identity-targeted harassment, racial slurs, and harmful stereotypes (e.g., anti-Black racism, stereotypes about Native Americans) using a multi-layered diagnostic multiple-choice framework.
